userId.description: An acct (@user or @user@host) names the opponent, for federated games.
@system lists the files the system owns (#686).

host.description: The host of the files, preferred to hostname.

resolved.description: Filters by whether the report is resolved, read when state is all, empty or null (before state existed).

reportId.description: Returns only this report, for the link of the abuse report notification (#2868).

name.description: The name of the copy; null keeps the name of the source.

category.description: The category of the copy; null keeps the source's.

aliases.description: The aliases of the copy; null keeps the source's.

license.description: The license of the copy; null keeps the source's.

isSensitive.description: Whether the copy is sensitive; null keeps the source's.

isActive.description: Whether the antenna is active; null and absent make it active again, like upstream does on an edit.

untilId.description: The cursor of the next page.

visibility.description: Who can see the page (#3479); null keeps it.

token.description: The two-factor authentication code; the bundled frontend sends null when two-factor authentication is off.

withSignins.description: false leaves out the sign-in history; null and absent include it.

noteIds.description: Returns these notes instead of the public notes (up to 100, like notes/show-partial-bulk).

password.description: The password of the account, checked when given (#1546).

allowPartial.description: Returns fewer notes than limit instead of reading on, like upstream does for the other timelines (the bundled frontend sends it to every timeline).

id.description: A decoration worn from a custom emoji has no id until it is saved: the bundled frontend sends an empty id with emojiName (#2975).

scale.description: The size of the decoration relative to upstream's; 1 when omitted (#2975).

emojiName.description: Wears the local custom emoji of this name instead of the decoration of id (#2975).

followApprovalAction.description: How a follow from an account younger than followApprovalLocalSeconds / followApprovalRemoteSeconds is handled (#3466); null leaves it as it is.
